description: Test suite for various line group resolution functions, including lookup IDs, config entries, history keys, account-scoped configurations, and group policies, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupLookupIds
methods.description: Expands a raw group or room ID into a list of prefixed and raw IDs.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupConfigEntry
methods.description: Resolves configuration entries for a group or room, supporting raw, prefixed, and wildcard entries.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupHistoryKey
methods.description: Generates a shared LINE peer key from group or room identifiers.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupsConfig
methods.description: Resolves the effective account-scoped groups map from the overall configuration.

methods.name: resolveExactLineGroupConfigKey
methods.description: Finds the specific configuration key for a given group within an account.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a LINE group requires a mention based on the configuration.
